Container.Name: dsh-sec
Container.Overview: DSH Web in a persistent, unprivileged container with a selectable DSH version.

Config.Name: SSH
Config.Description: SSH; if SSH_PORT changes, set Port Target to the same container port

Config.Name: DSH data
Config.Description: Persistent DSH home, profile, and settings

Config.Name: DSH version
Config.Description: NPM dist-tag or exact DSH version

Config.Name: SSH listen port
Config.Description: Container sshd listening port; if changed, set SSH port mapping Target to this same value

Config.Name: SSH password (optional)
Config.Description: Optional root password; blank disables password authentication. SSH login is fixed to root

Config.Name: Keyring unlock file (optional)
Config.Description: Optional root-only keyring password file; file mode 0400 or 0600. Missing or directory mount disables Keyring

Config.Name: Bind host
Config.Description: Leave blank to bind to the detected container address

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Externally reachable DSH Web base URL

Config.Name: Token registration URL (optional)
Config.Description: Optional endpoint for registering launch tokens; blank disables registration
